name: Early entry
about: Buys coins under 24 hours old that are up at least 10% in the last hour, where the rug score is under 20, the on-chain checks have come back and liquidity is at least $50k. Skips pumps where the average trade over the last hour is under $25, a sign of bots padding the activity. Skips any coin flagged as a rug risk in the last hour. Skips coins already up more than 650% in 24 hours. Puts in 2.5% of the wallet per buy. Sells on a Rug risk or Avoid verdict, at 10% down, after 60 minutes whatever the price, or at 20% up.
